# tree-sitter-zig parser

`parser.c` is generated by tree-sitter-zig 1.1.2 at commit
`6c2f4f90cab7c72ec27d9dd19361649cc59f41c2`.

It is vendored because the upstream Zig package's transitive build scripts do
not compile with Zig 0.16. Update it by replacing `parser.c` and
`tree_sitter/parser.h` from a newer tree-sitter-zig release and retaining the
upstream MIT license.
